boundaries: All vehicles and hours are invented model inputs, not a Texas deployment estimate.
Available hours exclude assumed downtime; occupied share is the part carrying passengers; remaining available hours include unoccupied activity.
Trip duration held constant; actual peak demand, repositioning, route/ODD constraints and support events could change output.
Trip is a completed occupied vehicle trip; no occupancy, passenger-journey or unique-user multiplication assumed.
Occupied hours and average trip duration refer to the same completed-trip population; interrupted occupied work is not silently counted as completed trips.
